description: Vertical flex stack with a consistent gap between children. Attribute form: any semantic element with data-layout="stack". With data-layout-align start/center/end, main/article/section/aside children drop container-type so they size to content instead of collapsing to zero width; add data-container to such a child to keep its container queries.

attributes.name: data-layout-gap
attributes.description: Gap between children, on the shared size scale.

attributes.name: data-layout-align
attributes.description: Cross-axis (inline) alignment of children. start/center/end make children content-sized (semantic sectioning children stop being query containers — see data-container).

childAttributes.name: data-container
childAttributes.description: Opt a semantic child back into container queries when the stack is aligned start/center/end. The layout removes container-type from such children so they size to content; this restores it (give the child an explicit inline size, or it collapses).
